title: Coordinate electricity, gas, lighting and ventilation
intro: Build a service-coordination drawing and approval record without replacing qualified electrical, gas or ventilation design and installation.

sections.title: Collect referenced service requirements
sections.text: Link each model’s service and access requirements to its manual and specialist drawing. The Bosch CPA565GS0B example assigns connection without a plug to a licensed professional. Furniture coordination identifies interfaces and owners; it does not select wiring, protection or connection procedures.
sections.caption: Each service has a requirement, source and responsible specialist.

sections.title: Distinguish extraction from room ventilation
sections.text: Do not assume a hood provides room ventilation. Miele DA7198W documentation distinguishes recirculation above a gas hob from ventilation of the room. Record operating mode, model and airflow route for ventilation/gas specialist review; do not derive a universal distance or duct size from an image.
sections.caption: Operating mode and room requirements need specialist review.

sections.title: Resolve conflicts before concealment
sections.text: Use common datums and mark proposed, approved and open items. Log drawer, access or airflow conflicts with owner, response, revised drawing and inspection evidence. Qualified specialists retain responsibility for electrical/gas work and testing under the applicable site and product requirements.
sections.caption: Concealing a conflict does not close it.

example.title: Worked case and decision
example.text: A cover blocks required service access while the specialist drawing remains unapproved. Hold concealment, coordinate removable access or an alternative, and record the specialist approval.
example.decision: Decision: document access and service approval before closure.

quiz.question: Does a finished front prove service acceptance?
options: No; specialist approvals and inspection are needed
quiz.explanation: Acceptance is evidenced and assigned, not inferred from appearance.

assignment.prompt: Submit a furniture/service overlay, referenced appliance record, three approval points and a conflict requiring a response.
criteria: No invented connection instructions or sizes

faq.question: Does every hood replace room ventilation?
faq.answer: No. Review the model, mode and room requirements with the specialist.
